Chapter 821: Chapter 22 Visiting Martial Ancestor (Please Subscribe)_2

In this situation, even if the Child of the Void gave it his all, he couldn’t do anything about the Martial Ancestor, so it was better to turn hostility into friendship.

At the level of the Child of the Void, the vast Boundless Void made his true desire to enter the Tenth Stage, and everything else appeared illusory.

“Let’s go.”

The Child of the Void glanced at the many Demonic Divine Masters, then directly used the power of the Void Secret Realm to start long-distance teleportation, heading towards Tianqing World.

…

Tianqing World.

...

Deep within the Martial Hall.

At this moment, intense spatiotemporal fluctuations filled the air. Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, the volatile power of space and the obscure power of time in front of him were as obedient as kittens, allowing themselves to be manipulated.

“So, this is the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm?”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face. Now that he had comprehended the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule and had thoroughly entered the Sixth Realm, he had stepped into the realm of the supreme.

Of course, it was only in terms of comprehension of space-time, barely reaching the level of the supreme, but in terms of actual strength, the gap with the supreme was still as insurmountable as the Grand Canyon.

If the comprehension of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule was a kind of skill, then factors affecting strength included not only skill but also inherent power.

Under the same skill level, if one’s strength was a hundred pounds, and another’s was a hundred tons,

the outcome of their battle would undoubtedly be a crushing defeat for the former. Moreover, the Space-Time Fusion Sixfold Realm was only the threshold for the supreme in the domain of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules.

Apart from this Fusion Rule, the supreme had mastered many other Fusion Rules, even transforming a certain pillar rule into a personal path.

“The Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm is a qualitative change, involving the power to break free from the bounds of the River of Time…”

Lin Yuan carefully observed the vast expanse of space-time, with numerous insights welling up in his heart.

The Space-Time Fusion Sixfold Realm was hailed as the domain of the supreme because, at this height, the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule had already begun to condense into a micro River of Space-Time.

Lin Yuan had no doubt that, if he wished, he now had the ability to impact the Ultimate realm.

The Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky generally believed that only by reaching the Eleventh Rank Peak could one attempt to reach the Ultimate realm, because only an Eleventh Rank Peak life form barely met the threshold of the Ultimate realm challenge.

But Lin Yuan?

Though he was only at the Tenth Stage, he was no different from those Eleventh Rank Peak life forms, and in certain aspects, he was even stronger, such as in the understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule and in the Mind and Will Index.

Of course, Lin Yuan indeed had the ability to impact the Ultimate, but whether he could succeed was another matter.

At the very least, even now, if Lin Yuan directly attempted the Ultimate, his likelihood of success would be slightly higher than that of legendary beings like the Four Divine Kings, due to the heavy influence of his comprehension of the Space-Time Fusion Rule at the Sixth Realm and a high Mind and Will Index.

“My inner world…”

Lin Yuan’s will descended into his inner world.

The greatest impact of reaching the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm on Lin Yuan was reflected in his inner world.

Within the inner world, the fusion of space-time had vaguely condensed into a micro River of Space-Time.

The emergence of the micro River of Space-Time, even though just a prototype, already altered the aura of the inner world.

“It’s a pity that the inner world still hasn’t broken its limit, exceeding a radius of 2.3 billion miles…” Lin Yuan felt a bit regretful but quickly accepted it.

The main universe’s Ten Thousand Races’ strong individuals, based on the limits of their own racial bloodlines, generally had inner worlds that ranged from millions to tens of millions of miles in radius.

Lin Yuan’s inner world, with a radius of 2.3 billion miles, had far surpassed any life in the main universe, including those unique special life forms.

“With my current understanding of the Space-Time Fusion Rule, if I aimed for the Eleventh Rank, enduring the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, could I break the shackles of my inner world?”

Lin Yuan speculated in his mind.

Normally, an Eleventh Rank Peak’s attempt to reach the Ultimate Realm, enduring the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, would cause a significant leap in the essence of life, freeing from the bindings of the River of Time, and the inner world would develop towards an inner universe.

All aspects of the inner world would break their former constraints. The supreme’s inner universe, in terms of diameter, would start from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of light-years.

This was why Lin Yuan, even having comprehended the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm, had no thought of being on par with the supreme. The gap was too vast. With an inner universe of tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of light-years, the amount of power that could be mobilized was unimaginable.

“We’ll find out when it comes time to challenge the Eleventh Rank.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while, then stopped thinking about it.

The conditions he currently had were unprecedented, neither within human civilization nor throughout the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky, or even in the long stretches of prior Cosmic Eras, could a precedent be found.

Ninth Rank impacting Tenth Rank, enduring Chaos Void Origin Infusion?

Tenth Stage comprehending the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm.

Mind and Will Index over 24 million at the Tenth Stage.

An inner world diameter reaching 2.3 billion miles.

And so on.

Any one of these conditions placed on a particular life form could dominate one or even several Cosmic Eras.

Were they now all concentrated in Lin Yuan? The future was entirely unpredictable.

…

Outside Tianqing World.

The Child of the Void and many Perfect Demon True Lords appeared successively.

“Is this the source of spatiotemporal fluctuations?”

“That being suspected of stepping into the Tenth Stage is in such a small world?”

“This is incredible.”

One by one, the Perfect Demon True Lords whispered to each other. Ordinarily, the stronger the life form, the higher its requirements for its residing space.
